mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (merchant_id, name, type, face_value, min_amount, total_count, received_count, used_count, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{faceValue}, #{minAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{receivedCount}, #{usedCount}, #{perUserLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, face_value = #{faceValue}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM coupon WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 1 AND start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
UPDATE coupon SET received_count = received_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE coupon SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
